name: As I Am
reference: As I Am (Dream Theater, Train of Thought, 2003, prod. Petrucci and Portnoy): the rhythm tone
rig: A Mesa Road King, which Petrucci chose because 'I was doing a lot of detunes... more of a saturated sound' (musicplayers.com 2007), into one Rectifier Traditional 4x12 with Vintage 30s, miked, for everything, recorded 'mostly dry' (BOSS Users Group). His nearest documented settings (2006): Vintage mode, 6L6, Pentode, presence low, mids at 9-10 o'clock, an SM57 off centre plus an MD421 into Neve pres, no compression (musicplayers.com 2006). Train of Thought was his first record with drop tunings; As I Am is C standard on a six-string (forum lore)
notes: Double-tracked, hard left/right, on the documented amp: Mesa Road King (Chameleon Audio captures), left Orange channel High, right Red channel High, each into a Mesa 4x12 V30 SM57. Dark, tight, saturated and dry (inferred): only a short 480L Small Wood Room at the house level. On the owner's seven-string in B standard, the C-standard riffs sit one fret up on the low B; a record-pitch option is tone.csv pitch_st (adds 11-31 ms), left empty. SW8 BOOST = TS9 push for leads, SW9 DELAY = 400 ms. Levelled offline with rigsim --exact to -14 LUFS.

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
Mesa Road King, Orange channel High

right.label: Mesa Road King, Red channel High
